test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

No book is a novel.

All novels are journals.

Conclusions:

I. No book is a journal.

II. No journal is a book.

III. Some journals are novels.

IV. All journals are novels.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Both conclusions I and IV follow
